messages:
maya: Heads-up — need a short-term standby GPU borrow for a customer demo tomorrow 10:00 PT. Rough ask: 4 H100-equivalent slots for ~2 hours. Can we pull from vendor standby or swap from a low-priority pool?

sanjay: who is the demo for and which region? need billing code + tenant id before we ping vendors.

maya: demo is for Acme analytics team, eu-west1 preferred but can fall back to us-west2. billing: ACME-DEMO-042. tenant: acme-prod.

jules: noted. if we use us-west2 we can avoid cross-region latency, but inventory looks tighter there. leo, any quick capacity peek?

leo: quick check: us-west2 has 2 free hot slots and 6 standby in vendor pool, eu-west1 has 0 hot and 3 standby. vendor pool can do 4 but needs 4h lead for allocation + billing mapping.

vendor-ops: we can carve 4 standby H100s for a 2h window. earliest provisioning start is +4h from now. we need the tenant tag and billing code on the request and a terraform tag so it maps to Acme invoice. also confirm exact start time.

maya: start time 2025-03-05T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). can you do +4h?

vendor-ops: that works. please create a request with these metadata: tenant=acme-prod, billing=ACME-DEMO-042, env=demo. once provisioned we will return an allocation id.

sanjay: creating a quick terraform snippet to tag the allocation in infra repo — pushing PR now.

sanjay: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_request" "acme_demo" {
  region = "us-west2"
  count = 4
  tags = {
    tenant = "acme-prod"
    billing = "ACME-DEMO-042"
    env = "demo"
  }
}
```

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7321 and scheduled vendor allocation workflow. vendor-ops assigned.

vendor-ops: once PR is merged and INF-7321 updated with allocation id, we'll schedule the carve and confirm ephemeral endpoints. expected confirmation ~T+3.5h after PR merged.

jules: @leo can you reserve the 2 hot slots as fallback in case vendor carve slips? mark as preemptible for cost.

leo: yep reserving 2 hot preemptible in us-west2 now. ETA ~15m.

maya: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when PR merged / ticket updated so I can lock demo script.

sanjay: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/1283 — adding INF-7321 refs. will merge after one quick review.

jules: review done, left one nit. merging after fix.

sanjay: fixed and merged. INF-7321 updated with allocation request.

ops-bot: INF-7321 status -> vendor_alloc_requested. vendor-ops assigned.

vendor-ops: confirmed allocation id ALLOC-20250305-77, provisioning scheduled for 2025-03-05T13:10:00Z. targeting ready by 2025-03-05T13:40:00Z (T+3.5h). will post endpoints when ready.

maya: perfect. leaving this thread open for any last-minute hiccups. :eyes:
